Page number at top left (152).

main_text.head: CLXXXIII.
Honoratior divortio non interrupta matrimonii copula.
main_text.p: Adeò ut hinc ad liberos etiam honoris aliquid autDivertium. maculæ accedat. pralata est Pollionis filia, non ob aliud, quàm quod mater ejus in eodem conjugio manebat. Nam Agrippa diffidio domum imminuerat. Si quis illud de vidua in ecclesiâ conventum legenda, γυναῖκα ἐνὸς ἀνδρὸς γυνή, quæ uni viro nupta fuerit, Ser. locus explicatur. 1.Tim.5.v.9. huc rapiat: forte non toto cœlo aberrat bit. Sanè fecunda, quæ JCti vocant, vota fœmineâ fexui non effe interdicta, ejufdem capitis 14.verficulo probatur. Violentius videtur, & illud de Episcopis, ac Diaconis, cap.3.v.2. & 12, huc trahere. quanquam non minor Ephefi, cujus ecclefiæ Timotheus præfi- debat, quam Romæ, ut luxuriæ abundantia, ita uxores dimittendi & alias ducendi licentia fervebat.
main_text.head: CLXXXIV.
Annonæ flagellatio moderatori reip. tollenda.
main_text.p: Non modò populi amore, fed & turbationis evi- tandæ. Sævitiam annonæ incufante plebe, statuit fru- mento pretium, quod emptor penderet, binofq; nummos Annona cura. se additurum negotiatoribus in singulos modios. Sæpè in frumenti penuria vilitas, in abundantia caritas, imperantium cura aut negligentia, perspicitur. quadre alibi copiosius differendi feges dabitur.
main_text.head: CLXXXV.
Humanæ capacitatis modulum excedentes honores vir sapiens non admittit.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left margin: "Divertium." (Divortium); "Ser. locus explicatur." ; "Annona cura."; "Divina occupationes." The left-margin notes are printed in italic. Text of the scan at the bottom is cut off at "quan-" and continues on the next page. Some letters are doubtful in the Greek and in the Latin ligatures; the Greek words in the second line of the body are copied as best read. The Greek phrase "γυναῖκα ἐνὸς ἀνδρὸς γυνή" is the transcriber's reading of the printed Greek and may contain errors [?]. Section headings CLXXXIII, CLXXXIV and CLXXXV are roman numerals as printed. The printed text of the third heading and of the final paragraph is partly hard to read and should be checked against the scan.
